newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: ICE HOCKEY-SLOVAKS SACK TEAM MANAGER GOLONKA.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-SLOVAKS SACK TEAM MANAGER GOLONKA.

text.p: Former Czechoslovak ice hockey international Jozef Golonka has been sacked as Slovakia's national team manager after just one season in the job, the official TASR news agency said on Wednesday.

Golonka, who was a pillar of the Czechoslovak team in the 1960s, was appointed last year to lead the emerging Slovak team which had worked its way up to world group A from group C after the split-up of Czechoslovakia.
Golonka guided the team to ninth place at this year's world championships in Finland. He will be replaced by Jan Sterbak.
